title: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire

entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: A young Temur hunter who resents being kept from Baishya's training but stands bravely behind the others when Atarka arrives.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: A young whisperer, Naiva's twin, kept close to Yasova.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: The former Temur chief who bargains with Atarka for the hunting band's lives.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: A young Jeskai ghostfire warrior who tells Atarka a story that is changed by a whispering voice.

entities.name: Fec
entities.description: A half-crippled orc cast out of the Kolaghan clan for being unable to keep up, now sheltered by Yasova.

entities.name: Darka
entities.description: A quiet ainok hunter whom Atarka seizes and eats.

entities.name: Rakhan
entities.description: An ainok hunter and Darka's kinsman who grieves his death.

entities.name: Oiyan
entities.description: A hunter of the party on watch.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The antlered Dragonlord who rules the Temur lands, who finds her broodling dead and eats Darka and the Ojutai dragon.

entities.name: Atarka's broodling
entities.description: A dragon of Atarka's brood that died after killing the Ojutai broodling, which Atarka calls her favorite.

entities.name: Ojutai's broodling
entities.description: The slender Ojutai dragon killed in battle; Yasova presents its corpse to Atarka as a kill by the hunters.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A pompous, ice-breathing Dragonlord who sent his favored broodling to kill Tae Jin.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon, central to the story told by Tae Jin, who manipulates humans and later dragons by whispering into their minds; the story casts him as a benevolent king.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Nicol's twin, who disappears into nothingness; Nicol recalls his words of warning.

entities.name: Vaevictis Asmadi
entities.description: A large bullying dragon who leads his brothers against Nicol's army and is turned on Lividus.

entities.name: Lividus
entities.description: A brother of Vaevictis, manipulated by Nicol into attacking him.

entities.name: Ravus
entities.description: A brother of Vaevictis, killed by the sorcerers' disintegration spell.

entities.name: Rubra
entities.description: A brother of Vaevictis who dies from a venom bolt to the eye.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: A hunting dragon, Nicol's sister, who listens to Nicol's tale of Vaevictis's vulnerability.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: A once-peaceful dragon who joins the great war after hearing whispers.

entities.name: Chromium Rhuell
entities.description: A clever dragon who hides himself pretending to be something else.

entities.name: Merrevia Sal
entities.description: The twins' sister killed by humans, whom Ugin mentions in Nicol's memory.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: A Jeskai leader at the last meeting of the khans.

entities.name: The dragon killer chief
entities.description: The human chief and his heirs in Tae Jin's story who preyed on dragons.

entities.name: Dragon tempest
entities.description: A storm that births dragons, passing over the camp.

entities.name: Ayagor
entities.description: The gathering place where Atarka feasts and takes hunting fledglings.

entities.name: Qal Sisma
entities.description: A mountain range where Atarka flies after her feast.

entities.name: Ugin's grave
entities.description: The chasm toward which the party is traveling.

entities.name: The birth mountain
entities.description: The mountain where the dragons hatched in the story.

entities.name: Kolaghan clan
entities.description: The orc clan that abandons those who cannot keep up.

entities.name: Ghostfire warriors
entities.description: Jeskai warriors who wield spectral blades.

entities.name: The Temur
entities.description: Yasova's clan, ruled by Atarka.

entities.name: Ainok
entities.description: The ainok people, of whom Darka and Rakhan are members.

entities.name: Eternal Ice
entities.description: The mountain where an avalanche tore away the snow field.

events.summary: A dragon tempest passes over the camp; Atarka arrives, finds her dead broodling, and drives the newborn dragons back into the storm.
events.quote: Slashing and raging, she drove the fledglings deeper into the night.

events.summary: A flash of golden light briefly shines as the tempest ends, and Naiva thinks she saw a shape falling through the stars.
events.quote: A flash of golden light flared like the sun rising at zenith

events.summary: Naiva walks point with Fec and learns he was cast out by the Kolaghan for his limp, and they argue about the old ways.
events.quote: In the Kolaghan clan those who cannot keep up are left behind.

events.summary: Atarka lands between the hunting band and the shelter, seizes Darka, and eats him.
events.quote: She bit off Darka's head before tossing his body in a high arc.

events.summary: Yasova tells Atarka that Ojutai's kin killed her broodling and that the hunters have killed the outsider as a feast for her.
events.quote: One of Ojutai's kin killed your broodling and fed on its innards.

events.summary: Atarka forces the party to follow her to the corpse and spots Tae Jin as an outsider smelling of Ojutai.
events.quote: He smells of Ojutai, that pompous, ice-breathing windbag.

events.summary: Yasova claims Tae Jin has come to serve Atarka and stops him from raising his ghostfire blade.
events.quote: Do not begin that which you cannot end.

events.summary: Atarka agrees to hear a story while she eats the Ojutai dragon before deciding Tae Jin's fate.
events.quote: Tell a story while I feast. Then I decide.

events.summary: Tae Jin begins a story but it twists, and he mutters that it isn't the story he meant to tell.
events.quote: That isn't the story I meant to tell. Let me try again.

events.summary: In the story, the young dragon king Nicol sets the human heirs against each other, loses his brother Ugin to a blast of sorcery, and rules as a just king.
events.quote: In the course of the war, his brother was swept away into nothingness by a blast of human sorcery

events.summary: Flashback: Dragons descended from Vaevictis raid the kingdom's settlements, and the king resolves to fight them with his army and venom-laced weapons.
events.quote: We are the descendants of Vaevictis Asmadi and may raid where we wish!

events.summary: Flashback: The king's army slaughters seven of Vaevictis's descendants with ballistae and sorcery but one escapes.
events.quote: It was a rout. A slaughter.

events.summary: Flashback: The king pursues the survivor across the plains and meets Vaevictis, Lividus, Ravus and Rubra, who drop the dead dragon onto the army.
events.quote: The corpse hit hard, instantly crushing an entire company of slingers.

events.summary: Flashback: The king's ballistae wound Rubra with a venom bolt, but the army is routed by Vaevictis's fire.
events.quote: Rubra took a bolt to the eye.

events.summary: Flashback: The king retreats into a canyon with a third of his army and plans a trap, thinking of Ugin and his search for a disintegration spell.
events.quote: For generations he had toiled in concert with his academy of sorcerers to recover or devise a magic that could replicate Ugin's disappearance.

events.summary: Flashback: The sorcerers' disintegration spell kills Ravus, and Lividus destroys the ballistae.
events.quote: Ravus splintered like rock heated until it explodes.

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol uses mind touch on Lividus to turn him against Vaevictis and sets the two brothers against each other.
events.quote: He pressed the venom-tipped spear of his sharp mind deep into Lividus's simmering rancor.

events.summary: Flashback: Vaevictis and Lividus fight each other as Nicol retreats and kills his own witnesses.
events.quote: Traitor! Backstabber!

events.summary: Flashback: Nicol spreads lies among the descendants of Vaevictis's brothers and Palladia-Mors, igniting clan wars among the dragons.
events.quote: The ease with which the gullible could be turned to his purpose was surprisingly pleasurable.

events.summary: Flashback: Dragons fight across the world and Arcades Sabboth joins the war after hearing whispers of wisdom.
events.quote: threw his might into the great war as he listened to the whispers of wisdom that brushed through his mind

events.summary: Atarka declares there is only one law, to eat, and spares Tae Jin before flying off.
events.quote: There is only one law: to eat. This was a good feast. You may keep the outsider.

events.summary: Tae Jin says the story came to him in a whisper, and Yasova warns that once before a whispering voice altered Tarkir and that she listened to it.
events.quote: Once before, a whispering voice sought to alter the events on Tarkir.

events.summary: The hunters honor Darka in the ainok manner and set out for Ugin's grave.
events.quote: His spirit walks ahead of us into the unwritten now,

relations.quote: She bit off Darka's head before tossing his body in a high arc.
For eighteen years my people have brought you meat in honor of our agreement.

relations.note: sheltered by her as one of the tribe
sent his broodling to hunt Tae Jin
relations.quote: Ojutai himself sent his own favored broodling to hunt down the man.

relations.note: calls Ojutai pompous; Yasova says to win a victory over him

relations.quote: Once called the least of his siblings, Nicol had traveled the continent of his birth with his brother Ugin
At last he could avenge the insult.
The three brothers, Lividus, Ravus, and Rubra, bellowed insults as they approached

relations.note: turned against each other by Nicol
relations.quote: Lividus rose to meet him with a roar.

relations.note: his sorcerers' disintegration spell kills Ravus
relations.quote: Ravus splintered like rock heated until it explodes.
